body:
# Approved copy

## 01-main

Enam robot AgiBot jaga minimarket 24 jam

Enam robot humanoid AgiBot G2 menjaga minimarket di Shanghai selama 24 jam. Semua angka hasilnya berasal dari AgiBot sendiri.

## 02-tugas

Tantangan bertajuk "Robots Never Clock Out" berlangsung dari 2 November pukul 10.00 hingga 3 November pukul 10.00 waktu China, di **minimarket di distrik Xuhui, Shanghai**. Robot G2 mengisi rak, membuat kopi, menyiapkan makanan, menyapa pembeli, dan membersihkan meja.

## 03-angka

Menurut AgiBot, mereka menyelesaikan 1.730 tugas, termasuk 683 sapaan dan 147 kopi. Siaran langsungnya ditonton lebih dari 2 juta orang. Tapi **hanya 4 dari 6 robot lulus penilaian**; robot pembersih dan satu robot patroli rak tidak lulus.

## 04-catatan

AgiBot tidak merilis tingkat keberhasilan. Seberapa sering manusia turun tangan juga tidak dirilis. Durasi 24 jam pun belum membuktikan robot bekerja mandiri tanpa henti. **Semua angka ini klaim AgiBot sendiri.**

# Caption

Enam robot humanoid AgiBot G2 menjaga sebuah minimarket di distrik Xuhui, Shanghai, selama 24 jam, dari 2 November pukul 10.00 hingga 3 November pukul 10.00 waktu China. Tantangan ini disiarkan langsung dengan judul "Robots Never Clock Out".

Menurut AgiBot, robot-robot itu menyelesaikan 1.730 tugas, dari menyapa pembeli, mengisi rak, membersihkan meja, sampai membuat 147 kopi. Siaran langsungnya ditonton lebih dari 2 juta orang. Namun hanya 4 dari 6 robot lulus penilaian, dan AgiBot tidak merilis tingkat keberhasilan maupun seberapa sering manusia turun tangan. Semua angka ini klaim AgiBot sendiri.

Kamu mau dilayani robot di minimarket?

# Source ledger

# Sources: Enam robot AgiBot jaga minimarket 24 jam

- AgiBot official X livestream replay, 2026-11-02: https://x.com/AGIBOTofficial/status/2117086439569867218 ("Robots Never Clock Out | AGIBOT G2's 24-Hour Convenience Store Challenge"; six G2 as convenience store trainees; on-screen 11.02–11.03 10:00–10:00). Footage source. The YouTube VOD (V9nxugBVArw) is "not available".
- Interesting Engineering, Jijo Malayil, 2026-11-03: https://interestingengineering.com/ai-robotics/agibot-humanoid-robots-in-convenience-store (2 Nov 10:00 to 3 Nov 10:00 China time; stocking, coffee, hot food, greeting, rubbish)
- Humanoids Daily, 2026-11-03: https://www.humanoidsdaily.com/news/agibot-g2-24-hour-convenience-store-livestream (24 h does not prove uninterrupted autonomy; no intervention policy published. Disclosure: its AI Day coverage was sponsored by AgiBot)
- TechSpot, 2026-11-03: https://www.techspot.com/news/114445-six-humanoid-robots-worked-24-hour-shift-convenience.html (Xuhui district, Shanghai; 1,730 tasks; 4 of 6 passed; the cleaning robot and one shelf-patrol robot did not, per ITHome; no success or takeover rate)
- RoBrief: https://robrief.com/en/articles/agibot-g2-24-hour-store-1730-tasks (683 greetings, 369 fetch/deliver, 277 restock/inspect, 147 coffees, 128 table cleanings, 126 breakfast orders; >2 million viewers)
- Servospace: https://servospace.io/news/agibot-g2-humanoids-24-hour-convenience-store-shift-1730-tasks (Securities Times citing AgiBot; VP Ren Guanghui spoke to reporters)

## Judgement calls

- All numbers (1,730 tasks, breakdown, viewers, 4 of 6 passed) come from AgiBot via secondary reports (Securities Times, ITHome); none independently verified. Copy says so ("Menurut AgiBot", "Semua angka ini klaim AgiBot sendiri").
- Shanghai/Xuhui and the task numbers are not in IE or Humanoids Daily; they come from TechSpot/RoBrief/Servospace citing AgiBot.
- "24 jam" is not presented as uninterrupted autonomy (slide 04, reel card 3).
